title: Lodge returns with the construction industry long service scheme
what: Employers in the construction industry lodge a return with the state's portable long service leave board after each return period.

laws.title: Construction Industry Long Service Leave Act 1987 (SA)

sources.title: Construction Industry Long Service Leave Act 1987 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 27—Returns by employers (1) Every employer in the construction industry must, within 21 days after the end of each period prescribed by the regulations (the return period), furnish the Board with a return

reach.condition: if it employs workers in the building and construction industry as the state scheme defines it

sources.title: Construction industry portable long service leave registration
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this registration to fulfil your obligations in relation to portable long service leave if you are an employer of eligible construction workers and operate in the construction industry.

confidence_note: Quoted from the law's current text on 10 Nov 2026, replacing the ABLIS-first draft (methods rule 5a); the ABLIS listing stays as a reach source.

assessment.summary: Employers in a covered industry must register with its portable long service leave scheme.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
